instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pair a community's members on its cadence without anyone asking: start a round when it is due, close it at its deadline, make introductions everyone said yes to, and follow up the ones nobody acted on", and give it community_id (The community whose matchmaker runs: its settings are the match-community record of this id.).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:advance-a-community-matchmaker and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The wake target of a community's matchmaker; a person declares it as their own wake (a wake-declaration record with tool tool:advance-a-community-matchmaker, a time repeat, and input { community_id }).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: match-community (records:read); match-member (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-round (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-ask (records:read, records:list, records:write); match (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-answer (records:read, records:list, records:write); ai-job (records:read, records:list, records:write); group (records:read, records:write).
